title: Likelihood Training of Schrödinger Bridge using Forward-Backward SDEs Theory
tldr_zh: 用 FBSDE 把 SB 最优性 PDE 改写为精确对数似然目标，SGM 的 ELBO 是其特例；CIFAR10 FID 3.01
tldr_en: FBSDE theory turns SB optimality PDEs into an exact log-likelihood objective generalizing SGM's ELBO; alternate IPF-style training reaches CIFAR10 FID 3.01.
key_numbers: CIFAR10 NLL 2.96 bits/dim, FID 3.01 vs Multi-stage SB 12.32, DOT 15.78 (Table 1)
Main text reports NLL 2.98 / FID 3.18 (Sec. 4), inconsistent with Table 1
Training time +6.8%, sampling time -80%, memory 2-2.5x vs SGM on CIFAR10 (Sec. 3.3)
